scripts.text:
You have too many items to proceed with the quest.
Please lighten your load and try again.
scripts.translation:
您攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。
請減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
You... don't look familiar to me... ?
Are you going to threaten me?
No, right?
scripts.translation:
[凱]
你……看起來很面生……？
你是來威脅我的嗎？
不是吧？

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I feel so grateful all the time about you letting me stay here.
It's nothing special... but if you want, I'll make you tools that could be of use.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
您願意讓我留在這裡，我一直心懷感激。
這不是什麼特別的東西……不過您需要的話，我可以做些實用的工具。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Ah... Master.
I feel so thankful all the time.
Since I owe you big time, I'll help you with anything anytime.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
啊……主人。
我一直非常感激您。
欠了您這麼大的人情，無論何時您需要，我都會盡力幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Ah stop following me around!
If you could just get rid of them... Hervor, that's right! I'll make you Hervor!
scripts.translation:
[凱]
啊，別再跟著我了！
只要您能幫我擺脫她們……對了，赫爾沃爾！我給您做一面赫爾沃爾盾！

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Did you hear the news?
The girls are coming.
The merciless girls!!!
scripts.translation:
[凱]
您聽說了嗎？
那些女孩要來了。
冷酷無情的女孩們！！！

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I can finally breathe now.
I'll start making Hervor as promised.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我總算能鬆口氣了。
我這就開始履行承諾，製作赫爾沃爾盾。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
... Although I managed to escape from them again...
it's hard.
life is... just so hard.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
……雖然我又設法逃過她們了……
但真不容易。
生活……實在太艱難了。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
From now on, I'll stay here quietly and not interrupt anyone until the siege ends.
Don't worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
攻城戰結束前，我會安靜地待在這裡，不打擾任何人。
不用擔心我。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'm tired a little bit.
I think I should rest for a few days.
I may look just fine, but I was mentally very tired.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我有點累了。
想休息幾天。
雖然看起來沒事，但我精神上已經非常疲憊了。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
It's strange.
I can't tell how I feel.
Am I having some kind of a health problem?
Is it something uncurable?
scripts.translation:
[凱]
真奇怪。
我也說不清自己是什麼感覺。
難道是身體出了什麼問題？
而且還治不好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I have my reasons.
Please, pretend not to see me.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我有自己的理由。
請當作沒看見我。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I mean if the guild master wants it.
I'm also a master who pursues the ultimate way.
I hope I can find that way here.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
只要公會會長願意就行。
我也是追求極致之道的工匠。
希望能在這裡找到那條道路。

scripts.text: Make Hervor.
scripts.translation: 打造赫爾薇爾

scripts.text: Fuse materials.
scripts.translation: 融合材料

scripts.text: Relax.
scripts.translation: 休息

scripts.text:
^ff0000Valkyrja's Shield is needed in the process of making Hervor.
You should not possess any other items except for Valkyrja's Shields in order to proceed with the quest.^ff0000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000打造赫爾薇爾需要瓦爾基里亞鋼盾。
繼續任務前，請確保身上除了瓦爾基里亞鋼盾，沒有其他物品。^ff0000

scripts.text:
^ff0000Even if the refinement level and cards have been applied, the process requires any one of the Valkyrja's Shields you may have.
Please try again after organizing your possessions.^000000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000製作時可能會選用你持有的任意一面瓦爾基里亞鋼盾，即使它已經精煉或鑲嵌卡片也不例外。
請整理好物品後再繼續。^000000

scripts.text: Organize possessions.
scripts.translation: 整理物品

scripts.text: Continue as it is.
scripts.translation: 就這樣繼續

scripts.text: You've decided to keep Valkyrja's Shields only.
scripts.translation: 您決定只保留瓦爾基里亞鋼盾。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I see that you've developed the fortress as you promised.
Moreover, you've found Velund's items...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
看來您如約發展了要塞。
而且還找到了維倫德的物品……

scripts.text:
[Kai]
... so..let's get the work done.
Before the girls find us...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
……那麼……趕緊開工吧。
趁那些女孩還沒找到我們……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The girls... ?

[Kai]
... yeah, there were some girls..
I had to run away because of them...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
……是啊，有一群女孩……
我就是因為她們才逃出來的……

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Oh, no... !
They're here..!!
scripts.translation:
[凱]
糟了……！
她們來了……！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Leave it to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
交給我吧。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Instruction -!
Soon, 7 girls that are after Kai will try to invade the fortress.
You have to protect Kai for 1 hour.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 說明 -!
很快，追著凱的7名女孩就會試圖入侵要塞。
你必須保護凱1小時。^000000

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Instruction -!
When the actual attack starts, the doorway of Emperium region will be blocked up for protection.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 任務說明 -!
正式進攻開始後，為便於防守，華麗金屬所在區域的入口將被封鎖。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Hervor is a shield named after Hervor the Valkyrie.
I didn't know this fortress would have the items that used to belong to Velund, a husband of Hervor...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
赫爾沃爾盾是以女武神赫爾沃爾命名的盾牌。
我沒想到這座要塞裡竟然有赫爾沃爾的丈夫維倫德曾經使用過的物品……

scripts.text:
[Kai]
If we use them, we could make Hervor.
It's like a dream come true for me... my hands are shaking.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
用這些材料就能製作赫爾沃爾盾。
這簡直像夢想成真一樣……我的手都在發抖。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
However, it seems like we need more materials.
Could you check again? I'll give you the list of what we need.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
不過看來還需要更多材料。
您能再確認一下嗎？我把所需清單給您。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
^4d4dff2 of Velund's Hammer
1 Velund's Anvil
4 Bronze bars with magical power
3 of Velund's Bracelet
1 Rune characters' Secret
1 Valkyrja's Shield
1 Muspellium and Essence of Rune, respectively^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱]
^4d4dff維倫德之錘2個
維倫德之砧1個
蘊含魔力的青銅錠4個
維倫德手鐲3個
符文文字的秘密1份
女武神之盾1面
穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華各1個^000000

scripts.text:
[Kai]
We need as many materials as these.
since it is a crystal of Velund's love.
By the way, Muspellium and Essence of Rune need to be made separately with additional materials.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我們需要這些材料。
畢竟這是維倫德愛情的結晶。
另外，穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華需要額外材料分別製作。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
In order to make Muspellium, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons^000000.
For Essence of Rune, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones^000000.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石需要^4d4dff合成50個鋁和50個神之金屬^000000。
製作符文精華需要^4d4dff合成200塊古代粗糙符文石和100塊神秘粗糙符文石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'll make Muspellium and Essence of Rune anytime upon your request,
and of course, I'll make Jormungand as soon as we gather all the materials needed.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
只要您開口，我隨時可以製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華。
當然，材料一齊，我也會馬上製作耶夢加得。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
What I'm doing is never enough compared to what you've done for me.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
與您為我所做的一切相比，我做的這些根本不算什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
However, would it be okay if I said something?
Hervor is one of the most powerful battlegears I make and you deserve to receive something like that from me...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
不過，我能說幾句嗎？
赫爾沃爾盾是我能製作的最強裝備之一，您值得擁有這樣的裝備……

scripts.text:
[Kai]
but I would like you to have the minimum qualification at least.
Manage this fortress well and raise ^4d4dffits commerce level by 30 or more^000000.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
不過我希望您至少達到基本條件。
請好好經營這座要塞，將^4d4dff商業等級提升至30級以上^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
With great power comes great responsibility and duty.
I would like you to master the basics first.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
力量越大，責任和義務也越大。
我希望您先掌握好基礎。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'll make you Hervor afterward.
Let me give you the list of materials if you want.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
之後我會為您製作赫爾沃爾盾。
需要的話，我可以把材料清單給您。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
^4d4dff2 of Velund's Hammer
1 Velund's Anvil
4 Bronze bars with magical power
3 of Velund's Bracelet
1 Rune characters' Secret
1 Valkyrja's Shield
1 Muspellium and Essence of Rune, respectively^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱]
^4d4dff維倫德之錘2個
維倫德之砧1個
蘊含魔力的青銅錠4個
維倫德手鐲3個
符文文字的秘密1份
女武神之盾1面
穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華各1個^000000

scripts.text:
[Kai]
We need as many materials as these.
since it is a crystal of Velund's love.
By the way, Muspellium and Essence of Rune need to be made separately with additional materials.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我們需要這些材料。
畢竟這是維倫德愛情的結晶。
另外，穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華需要額外材料分別製作。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
In order to make Muspellium, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons^000000.
For Essence of Rune, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones^000000.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石需要^4d4dff合成50個鋁和50個神之金屬^000000。
製作符文精華需要^4d4dff合成200塊古代粗糙符文石和100塊神秘粗糙符文石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'll make Muspellium and Essence of Rune anytime upon your request,
and of course, I'll make Jormungand as soon as we gather all the materials needed.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
只要您開口，我隨時可以製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華。
當然，材料一齊，我也會馬上製作耶夢加得。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
However, you won't be able to find Velund's items.
... but people say they definitely appear to those who truly want it. I wish you all the luck.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
不過，您未必能找到維倫德的物品。
……但據說只要真心渴望，它們就一定會出現。祝您好運。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Which material do you want to make?
scripts.translation:
[凱]
您想製作哪種材料？

scripts.text: Muspellium
scripts.translation: 精魔礦石

scripts.text: Essence of Rune
scripts.translation: 符文魔力精髓

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'll make Muspellium with the materials you've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我會用您準備好的材料製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'll make Essence of Rune with the materials you've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我會用您準備好的材料製作符文精華。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Tell me whenever you need it.
I'm glad I can at least do this for you.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
需要的時候儘管告訴我。
至少能為您做這些，我很高興。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
In order to make Muspellium,
^4d4dffyou need 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons.^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱]
製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石，
^4d4dff需要50個鋁和50個神之金屬。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kai]
For Essence of Rune,
^4d4dffyou need 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones.^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱]
製作符文精華，
^4d4dff需要200塊古代粗糙符文石和100塊神秘粗糙符文石。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kai]
We should have all the materials ready, right?
scripts.translation:
[凱]
材料應該都準備齊了吧？

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Surely, it takes a lot...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
確實需要不少材料……

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Also, a place where you can find materials for Hervor...
this is like a dream place for me, too.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
而且，這裡還能找到製作赫爾沃爾盾的材料……
對我來說，這裡也像夢境一樣。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
It shouldn't take long.
Here it is.
It is an essential material for making Hervor and Jormungand.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
應該很快就能弄好。
給您。
這是製作赫爾沃爾盾和耶夢加得必不可少的材料。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
That is so nice of you to say that.
By the way, I wonder how my younger brother Cano is doing?
scripts.translation:
[凱]
您這麼說真好。
對了，不知道我弟弟卡諾現在怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'm sure he's doing fine just like I am.
... I hope things stay as peaceful as they are now.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我相信他和我一樣過得很好。
……希望日子能一直像現在這樣平靜。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
They'll get here any minute since they've declared war already.
I'm sure they're coming to get Hervor.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
她們已經宣戰，隨時可能趕到。
我敢肯定她們是衝著赫爾沃爾盾來的。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Stop them. Please!
scripts.translation:
[凱]
請阻止她們！

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧

scripts.text: What do you mean 'the girls?'
scripts.translation: 你說的“那群女孩”是指？

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Thank you...
I'm sorry that I'm causing you troubles, but my hands are tied.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
謝謝您……
給您添麻煩了，實在抱歉，可我也無能為力。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Please, stop them for me!
scripts.translation:
[凱]
拜託，請替我阻止她們！

scripts.text:
[Kai]
... They are the girls who want to be Valkyries...
and they always go around in groups of seven.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
……她們是想成為女武神的女孩……
總是七個人一起行動。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
What they want is a powerful battlegear...
They always threatened my younger brother Cano and me.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
她們想要強大的戰鬥裝備……
一直在威脅我和弟弟卡諾。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
They were satisfied with basic weapons at first, but
soon they started threatening us saying that they need something more powerful in order to become Valkyries.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
一開始她們對基礎武器還算滿意，
但很快就開始威脅我們，說要成為女武神就必須擁有更強大的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I couldn't stand it, so I ran away... but they're here...
You have to be careful since they found out that materials for Hervor are here.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我受不了就逃了出來……可她們還是追來了……
她們已經知道赫爾沃爾盾的材料在這裡，您一定要小心。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
When will they ever stop following me...
Now I'm scared of girls in general... and I'm too scared to do anything...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
她們到底什麼時候才肯放過我……
現在我見到女孩就害怕……什麼都不敢做了……

scripts.text:
He's babbling now.
Just wait and he'll calm down.
You have to get rid of those girls first.
scripts.translation:
他已經語無倫次了。
等一會兒，他就會冷靜下來。
你得先把那些女孩趕走。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'm so exhausted that I can't do anything.
... I don't think I can do anything for a while, whether it's producing or smithing or whatever it is.
I'm sorry. I'll take a break.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我累得什麼都做不了了。
……不管是製作還是鍛造，最近我都沒法工作。
對不起，我要休息一陣子。

scripts.text: Make Hervor.
scripts.translation: 打造赫爾薇爾

scripts.text: Fuse materials.
scripts.translation: 融合材料

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 現在不行

scripts.text:
^ff0000Valkyrja's Shield is needed in the process of making Hervor.
You should not possess any other items except for Valkyrja's Shields in order to proceed with the quest.^ff0000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000打造赫爾薇爾需要瓦爾基里亞鋼盾。
繼續任務前，請確保身上除了瓦爾基里亞鋼盾，沒有其他物品。^ff0000

scripts.text:
^ff0000Even if the refinement level and cards have been applied, the process requires any one of the Valkyrja's Shields you may have.
Please try again after organizing your possessions.^000000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000製作時可能會選用你持有的任意一面瓦爾基里亞鋼盾，即使它已經精煉或鑲嵌卡片也不例外。
請整理好物品後再繼續。^000000

scripts.text: Organize possessions.
scripts.translation: 整理物品

scripts.text: Continue as it is.
scripts.translation: 就這樣繼續

scripts.text: You've decided to keep Valkyrja's Shields only.
scripts.translation: 您決定只保留瓦爾基里亞鋼盾。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Oh... thank you.
I can't believe I'm finally touching these materials myself...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
啊……謝謝您。
真不敢相信，我終於能親手觸碰這些材料了……

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Here it is.
Wasn't it fast although we had to go through many steps?
I was so overwhelmed that it felt as short as a moment.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
做好了。
雖然步驟不少，但不是很快嗎？
我太投入了，感覺一眨眼就完成了。

scripts.text:
Hervor, a shield that Blacksmith Velund made for his wife Hervor, is finally made
at the hands of Kai.
scripts.translation: 鐵匠維倫德為妻子赫爾沃爾打造的盾牌——赫爾沃爾盾，終於由凱親手完成了。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Whew.. I don't think I can work for a while.
I'm all exhausted. Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
呼……我一陣子都沒法工作了。
已經筋疲力盡了，哈哈哈……

scripts.text:
[Kai]
However, it seems like we need more materials.
Could you check again? I'll give you the list of what we need.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
不過看來還需要更多材料。
您能再確認一下嗎？我把所需清單給您。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
^4d4dff2 of Velund's Hammer
1 Velund's Anvil
4 Bronze bars with magical power
3 of Velund's Bracelet
1 Rune characters' Secret
1 Valkyrja's Shield
1 Muspellium and Essence of Rune, respectively^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱]
^4d4dff維倫德之錘2個
維倫德之砧1個
蘊含魔力的青銅錠4個
維倫德手鐲3個
符文文字的秘密1份
女武神之盾1面
穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華各1個^000000

scripts.text:
[Kai]
We need as many materials as these.

By the way, Muspellium and Essence of Rune need to be made separately with additional materials.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我們需要這些材料。

另外，穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華需要額外材料分別製作。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
In order to make Muspellium, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons^000000.
For Essence of Rune, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones^000000.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石需要^4d4dff合成50個鋁和50個神之金屬^000000。
製作符文精華需要^4d4dff合成200塊古代粗糙符文石和100塊神秘粗糙符文石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'll make Muspellium and Essence of Rune anytime upon your request,
and of course, I'll make Jormungand as soon as we gather all the materials needed.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
只要您開口，我隨時可以製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石和符文精華。
當然，材料一齊，我也會馬上製作耶夢加得。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
What I'm doing is never enough compared to what you've done for me.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
與您為我所做的一切相比，我做的這些根本不算什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Which material do you want to make?
scripts.translation:
[凱]
您想製作哪種材料？

scripts.text: Muspellium
scripts.translation: 精魔礦石

scripts.text: Essence of Rune
scripts.translation: 符文魔力精髓

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'll make Muspellium with the materials you've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我會用您準備好的材料製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
I'll make Essence of Rune with the materials you've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
我會用您準備好的材料製作符文精華。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Tell me whenever you need it.
I'm glad I can at least do this for you.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
需要的時候儘管告訴我。
至少能為您做這些，我很高興。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
In order to make Muspellium,
^4d4dffyou need 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons.^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱]
製作穆斯貝爾海姆礦石，
^4d4dff需要50個鋁和50個神之金屬。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kai]
For Essence of Rune,
^4d4dffyou need 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones.^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱]
製作符文精華，
^4d4dff需要200塊古代粗糙符文石和100塊神秘粗糙符文石。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kai]
We should have all the materials ready, right?
scripts.translation:
[凱]
材料應該都準備齊了吧？

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Surely, it takes a lot...
scripts.translation:
[凱]
確實需要不少材料……

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Also, a place where you can find materials for Hervor...
this is like a dream place for me, too.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
而且，這裡還能找到製作赫爾沃爾盾的材料……
對我來說，這裡也像夢境一樣。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
It shouldn't take long.
Here it is.
It is an essential material for making Hervor and Jormungand.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
應該很快就能弄好。
給您。
這是製作赫爾沃爾盾和耶夢加得必不可少的材料。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Now is actually the right time to make it.
By the time next Emperium appears, there won't be any chances left.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
現在正是製作它的好時機。
等下一個艾爾帕蘭之心出現時，就沒有機會了。

scripts.text:
[Kai]
Also, keep in mind the fact that I can only do this once a week.
scripts.translation:
[凱]
另外請記住，我每週只能製作一次。

scripts.translation: 密碼？

scripts.translation: 走開
